text:
ana (Marketing): Quick sync — greenroom walkthrough for the 'Practical Inference at Scale' webinar, 2026-03-31 09:00 PT. Need run-of-show + speaker kit + demo fallback plan.

mike (Growth): Ack. Do we have final speaker slide decks? also want a 30s promo clip for socials.

julia (Product): I have abstracts and the demo script. Uploading assets to the drive now. @sam can you confirm the staging demo will run on dedicated infra?

sam (Eng): Can run on staging but need 48h to provision a small Dedicated pool and a hosted fallback. Also recommend a low-latency cached path for the live demo.

ana (Marketing): @sam good — include a 'low-touch' fallback that uses Redwood Hosted API so we can pivot if dedicated hits quota.

mike (Growth): For attendee routing, let's send a pre-webinar prompt pack and a short survey. Can ops include the routing links in the reminder emails?

ana (Marketing): Yes. I'll add call-to-action links and a sticky lead capture during Q&A.

julia (Product): Draft run-of-show (rough):
```
09:00 - Greenroom opens (hosts + speakers)
09:15 - Final mic/screen checks + demo warmups
09:30 - Attendees join, welcome slide
09:35 - Talk 1 (15m) + demo (5m)
09:55 - Breakout demo (live) + fallback video ready
10:10 - Panel Q&A (20m) + live prompts from audience
10:30 - Close + CTA (5m)
```

julia (Product): Notes: the live demo window is 09:55-10:05. We should practice a 90s canned fallback video that we can switch to with one click.

sam (Eng): Suggest we add a short heartbeat check that runs every 30s in the greenroom to validate token throughput and latency. If latency > 500ms for 3 checks, auto-route to hosted fallback. I can script that.

ana (Marketing): Perfect. Can you put the routing policy in a tiny doc? we'll reference it in the cue cards.

sam (Eng): Will do. Example pseudo-policy: `if p99_latency > 500ms and error_rate > 1% then route -> hosted-fallback-v2`

mike (Growth): Who's owning the speaker cue cards? I can own the host scripts but need speaker lines and handoff cues.

julia (Product): I'll create cue cards for speakers (what to say at handoff, timing, fallback line).

ana (Marketing): Assignments:
- ana: reminder emails + CTAs + social 30s clip
- mike: host script + attendee routing links
- julia: cue cards + abstracts + demo script
- sam: staging provisioning + heartbeat + routing doc + backup video integration

ana (Marketing): Rehearsals:
- Wed 3/26 9am PT: tech check (all speakers + eng)
- Fri 3/28 9am PT: full run-through with audience flow

mike (Growth): I'll spin up the pre-webinar survey and mock reminder email. Posting draft in #marketing-drafts.

julia (Product): One more ask — can we get one practice prompt set to validate that the hosted fallback produces similar outputs? saves on regressions during the show.

sam (Eng): Yep, will run evals on both endpoints and attach a short diff report.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-29 09:00 PT — "Greenroom tech check: counters, routing, fallback video"

ana (Marketing): Thanks team — this looks good. I'll assemble the final run-of-show doc and share before EOD tomorrow. Please upload any final slides and the fallback video link by EOD Tuesday. :thumbsup:
